title: Extend a Capability Without Forking Nodics
readerIntent: Customize an existing capability in a customer project while preserving upgrades.
priorKnowledge: Know the owning capability and layer.
owner: Customer project module layered over an owning Nodics capability
summary: Prefer configuration, then a documented extension or override, and create new behavior only when the existing contracts cannot express the requirement.

sections.heading: Extension sequence
items: Search for an existing implementation, property, service, interceptor, pipeline node, event, schema extension, or route contract.
Configure existing behavior when only a supported choice or value changes.
Override or extend the smallest owning layer when behavior changes.
Keep the customization in the customer project module and preserve the original contract unless a versioned change is intentional.
Add a new framework mechanism only after a duplication and parallel-authority assessment.

sections.heading: Example
paragraphs: If a project needs additional employee validation, extend the profile-owned validation or save-interceptor contract in the project layer. Do not copy the employee schema, create a direct database write, or validate only in Axis.

sections.heading: Required proof
items: Default behavior remains unchanged without the project module.
Customized behavior activates only in the intended project and scope.
Positive, negative, boundary, contract, integration, and regression tests pass.
Documentation explains the extension point, configuration, limitations, operations, and upgrade considerations.
